why: splendor-v1 and blue-v1 rebased onto V11. Both were authored against V10 and neither is mergeable as written: diffed against the sleeved list they read as cutting Horn of Greed, Isochron Scepter and Mind Stone, which is not a decision either made — it is the artifacts-v1 merge showing through, since V10 held Angelic Wall, Forced Fruition and Mikaeus in those slots. Their real content is three swaps between them: Gleaming Splendor and Greater Auramancy for Alhammarret's Archive and Lightning Greaves, plus the colour audit's one land. Kefnet the Mindful needs no slot — it is already in the 99 and declared as a flier blocker, which matters because 39 of 53 eliminations in the audit came from the air. The objective is interaction affordability at turn six, 0.610 on the sleeved list: Gleaming Splendor's Treasures are mana this deck can hold up, and both colours are double-digits short of Karsten.

commits.message: splendor-v1 and blue-v1, rebased onto V11: three swaps, nothing reverted

staged.why: splendor-v1's original one-card patch. The Archive is {5} and doubles your own draw; Gleaming Splendor is {1}{W} and taxes the table's. Heliod's whole engine is making EVERY player draw, so 'whenever an opponent draws their SECOND card each turn' fires on three seats every turn the engine runs, and each trigger is a Treasure. Four mana cheaper, and it turns the deck's own symmetry into mana.

splendor-v1's second swap. Greaves protects one creature from targeting; Greater Auramancy gives hexproof to EVERY enchantment you control and shroud to other creatures. This 99 is enchantment-dense and the commander is an enchantment creature — it protects the engine rather than a single body.

The 2026-09-16 colour audit, and the whole of what blue-v1 actually changed. Blue is 62.9% of the deck's pips on 26 sources against a Karsten target of 36; white is 37.1% of pips on 25. Moving one basic from the colour with the lighter load to the one that binds.

proposal.why: The real content of splendor-v1 and blue-v1, rebased onto the sleeved V11 so neither reverts the artifact package merged as v1.3.0. Gleaming Splendor for Alhammarret's Archive: three mana cheaper, and it turns the deck's own symmetry into mana — Heliod makes every player draw, so the second-card trigger fires on three seats a turn and each one is a Treasure. Greater Auramancy for Lightning Greaves: hexproof for every enchantment protects the engine rather than one body, and the commander is an enchantment creature. One Plains to one Island for the 2026-09-16 colour audit, where blue is 61% of the deck's pips. Kefnet the Mindful needs no slot; it is already in the 99 and already declared as a flier blocker.
